title: Plan for Weather and Monsoon Conditions
content: Karnataka has varied climates across its coast, hills, and inland regions. Check local forecasts and road conditions before setting out, especially during monsoon periods.

title: Respect Heritage Sites and Local Communities
content: Follow site rules at heritage monuments, avoid touching or damaging structures, and respect local customs and community spaces.

title: Check Timings Before Visiting Attractions
content: Opening hours, access rules, and ticket availability may change. Confirm current details with official attraction sources before your visit.

title: Keep Your Karnataka Trip Flexible
content: Allow extra time for transfers and weather. Build an itinerary around nearby destinations rather than trying to cover too many places in one day.
